title: The Delivery Nobody Recorded
stamp: Bad data in = expensive chicken out.

scenes.text: Here’s the real culprit. Yesterday’s delivery arrived, but nobody recorded it.
The system says zero chicken. The kitchen says forty kilos. I asked the database. It said, “Ask Dave.”
And I’m the one on trial? A well-designed system waits for the delivery to be recorded before it checks the stock. That’s not AI autonomy. That’s a data problem wearing an AI costume.
